claim.claim-text: 2. The pipe insulation assembly of claim 1, wherein a first side of the second lip (3200) is exposed when the jacket (110) is closed.

3. The pipe insulation assembly of claim 2, wherein the exposed first side of the second lip (3200) has dimensional markings (140) that are visible outside the jacket (110) when the jacket (110) is closed.
4. The pipe insulation assembly of claim 3, wherein the dimensional markings (140) are made using an invisible ink.
5. The pipe insulation assembly of claim 1, wherein dimensional markings (140) are placed directly on the jacket (110) and are made using an invisible ink.
7. The pipe insulation assembly of claim 6, wherein a thickness of the second adhesive (210) is greater than a thickness of the first adhesive (420).

8. The pipe insulation assembly of claim 6, wherein the second adhesive (210) is closer to an end of the extended lip portion (200) closest from the longitudinal slit (400) than the first adhesive (420).
